subject: Insurance
title: The Dead Doctor Scam
description: A quick win: understand The Dead Doctor Scam.

hook.text: In 2010, a man in Indiana bought $15 million in life insurance, then faked his death in a staged car accident.

buildup.text: Marcus Schrenker crashed his private plane on autopilot, parachuted out.

discovery.text: Investigators found the plane crashed but had no blood, no body, and no damage consistent with a fatal impact.

twist.text: Schrenker was found in a campground within days. He had attempted suicide when he realized escape was impossible.

climax.text: He was sentenced to 10 years for fraud and destruction of an aircraft.

punchline.text: Parachuted from his own plane. No body at the crash site revealed the fraud.

quiz.question: How did investigators discover Schrenker faked his death?
options: The crash site had no body and no blood
